title: PromptGuard: An Orchestrated Prompting Framework for Principled Synthetic Text Generation for Vulnerable Populations using LLMs with Enhanced Safety, Fairness, and Controllability
reasoning: The paper's primary objective is the development of a framework that integrates ethical principles directly into the LLM generation process. It utilizes 'Principled AI Ethics Theory' as a foundational pillar and includes an 'Ethical Principles Integration Module' as one of its core components, going far beyond a standard disclosure section to make ethical and moral alignment a central part of the technical architecture.
